body:
selfhost/emit.prn now supports a struct-field read as a let-binding value, closing a real gap confirmed via a direct probe: get-field was never wired into emit-let-value at all, even for a plain scalar field, falling to an honest #error. Scalar-only v0, boxed via emit-i32-boxed matching the pre-existing tail-position convention; a struct-typed field as a let-value is honestly flagged as still unsupported (no declared return type to special-case against, unlike a defn body). 6 new tests including a real compile+run+assert check. Zero regressions: 336-test suite + all 6 selfhost domains + bazel build/test clean. PARENA commit 67e55d3.

⚓ ☃
title: Self-hosted compiler: get-field-as-a-let-value support
